name: GitLab CLI
description: Installs the GitLab CLI (`glab`), persists its configuration directory, and configures GitLab CLI as a Git credential helper via the shared `git-config` Feature.

persist.description: Persist GitLab CLI configuration by linking ~/.config/glab-cli to the host home directory.

version.description: GitLab CLI version to install (e.g., 1.126.0). Use 'latest' for the most recent release.
